data.comment:
# Comfy Wan3.0- Reference to Video

Generate a video from two reference images using Wan3.0's reference-to-video capability, which produces up to 30 seconds of footage with character consistency and lifelike visuals. Ideal for creating consistent character animations, scene replication from visual references, and producing audiovisual content from static imagery. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wan3_0_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt:
Generate a 5-second, 16:9 street dance shoe showcase video: using @Image1 as the shoe reference and @Image2 as the character reference, a young man wearing the orange-and-white sneakers performs a street dance routine in front of a deep-blue backdrop, showcasing the shoes in motion throughout.

Multimodal reference layer:
- @Image1 (product spec): strictly keep the shoe design: the orange-and-white color blocking, streamlined silhouette, engineered mesh upper, breathable textile lining, dual-density midsole foam, Max-Air unit at the heel, and dynamic lacing system; ignore the callout text, arrows, numbering, and exploded view in the original
- @Image2 (character portrait): strictly keep the character and the backdrop tone: a young man with short dark hair, a plain grey hoodie, futuristic white-framed sunglasses with blue iridescent lenses, on a deep-blue background; no text anywhere in the frame

Global settings:
- Scene and materials: seamless deep-blue studio backdrop matching the character reference, subtle floor reflections; streetwear commercial texture, high saturation and contrast
- Visual style: hip-hop dance commercial, dynamic composition with a strong edit feel, the orange-and-white shoe as the visual anchor against the deep blue
- Camera language: opening tilt-down to the feet, low-angle follow on the footwork, closing slide-and-freeze, the camera glued to the shoe's movement the whole time
- Lighting: hard top light plus side-backlight with a cool rim glow, the floor reflecting the shoe's motion trail

Storyboard:
[0-1.5s] Slide-in entry: the character glides sideways into frame from off-screen, body grooving to the beat, the camera whipping down from a half-body shot to the feet, the orange-and-white sneaker drawing a smooth slide across the floor, sole squeaking softly

[1.5-3.5s] Dance combo: the character chains a wave, kick, spin, and squat in a continuous street dance combo, the camera following the footwork low-angle as mesh texture, dynamic lacing, and the translucent air unit flash clearly in the fast motion, every landing hitting the floor with a crisp thud
[3.5-5s] Hero freeze: the character slides on one knee to the camera, leaning back with one finger pointed at the lens; the camera finishes on a close-up of the shoe, the orange-and-white sneaker stopping dead center, freezing into a dynamic hero shot

Audio design: layered ambience: heavy-bass hip-hop beat with DJ scratches; sole friction, shoe landings, and fabric whip sounds, every move landing on the beat; no dialogue, no voiceover.

Negative constraints: hands never in pockets; no text, graffiti, callouts, or UI anywhere in the frame; no subtitles, no black frames, no jump cuts, no camera shake; do not alter the shoe's colorway or the character's outfit.
